cohort: The study included 2605 patients at least 37 weeks' gestation who were admitted for labor with intended vaginal birth.
finding: N(2)O use in multiparous patients was associated with a 17% decrease in the use of neuraxial analgesia, but no association was found between N(2)O use and neuraxial analgesia in nulliparous patients, nor with cesarean birth in either group.
mod_finding: N(2)O use was not associated with cesarean birth in either nulliparous or multiparous patients.
